catalogue.name: The Chambers
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Stoic Chamber
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Shield of Defiance: use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a friendly regular unit. It has Defence(re-roll) for this attack.
● Seize the initiative: use when determining initiative. If your opponent would get it, you get it instead. Alternatively, use it as the “Snatch the Initiative” FP option, but retain your FP on 5+.
● Tactical Mastery: use when an enemy unit deploys onto the board with insertion or Ambush. It receives one (1) action marker.

sharedRules.name: Ferocious Chamber
sharedRules.description:
1x Chambers Assault Squad does not count as a special choice.

You may not make voluntary withdrawal moves. 

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Always Forward!: use before game. One (1) friendly Chamber Squad OR Assault Squad gets Vanguard.
● Furious Charge: one (1) friendly unit gets Charge(3) for one (1) attack.
● Rage: use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: Dark Chamber
sharedRules.description:
1x Tanksuit Squad OR Light Hovercraft unit does not count as a special choice.

You may not field more of other special units than Bike Squad, Tanksuit and Light Hovercraft units combined.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Hunters must be patient: use when determining initiative. If you would have it, your opponent gets it instead. Alternatively, use it as the “Snatch the Initiative” FP option, but retain your FP on 5+.
● Shellgame tactics: use when you have initiative. One (1) friendly unit within 18” of a friendly board edge and more than 12” from enemy units is removed and placed within 12” of a friendly board edge and more than 12” from enemy units.
● We have a list: all attacks versus one (1) enemy unit has loathing until end of game.

sharedRules.name: Logic Chamber
sharedRules.description:
1x Chamber Mech does not count as a special choice.

You may not field Aircraft, VTOL, Scout or Hover transport units. 
You may not field more Bike or Assault units than other core choices. (not enforced in BS)

Chamber squad units may purchase Siege Shields: Defence(min 4), Tough(+1) (+2p each)
Add the Kerberos Digger (see the ARES force list) to your Battle Transports.
Add Machine Adept: Vehicle Repair to your Adept options.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Bionic enhancement: all friendly unarmed regular units get CC (2) until end of turn.
● Machine endurance: use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a friendly Massive or Vehicle unit. It has Defence(re-roll) for this attack.
● Target priority: all regular model attacks versus one (1) enemy unit have Masterwork until end
of game.

sharedRules.name: Watch Chamber
sharedRules.description:
1x Veteran squad or Watch Termination team does not count as a special choice.

You may not field Chamber Scout units. 
You may not field more vehicles without the Capacity trait than with. (not enforced in BS)

Add the following to your support weapons list:
Chamber AGL: 18” (3), blast(half) (15p)
HMG w combined Heavy flamer (15p)

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Deploy tanglers: use when a CC attack is made vs a friendly unit. It gets Repel(2) until end of turn.
● Rapid reactions: use when a regular unit makes a ranged reaction attack. It gets First Strike.
● Target-appropriate ammunition: use before a regular unit makes a ranged attack vs a non-
vehicle target. It gets wound(re-roll).

sharedRules.name: Masters of all weapons
sharedRules.description:
When attacking, select option:
» Up to two (2) models may attack with any support weapon, the rest with Slugger OR Slug pistol OR Vibrosword
» Up to one (1) model may attack with any support weapon and up to half (round up) with any specialist weapon OR Energy axe/sword/fist OR Plasma pistol
